title: helper text changes field height
rule: Helper text changes field height — a field with helper text next to one without will misalign. Equalize by passing a space character as `helperText` on the sibling.
pass_when: Adjacent fields with/without helper text stay aligned (sibling gets space `helperText` or equivalent).
fail_when: Adjacent fields misalign because only one has helper text.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Helper association `id` (next row) as this height row.
